See the man page for more details. #### Dependencies - The verbs provider requires libibverbs (v1.1.8 or newer) and librdmacm (v1.0.16 or newer). If you are compiling Libfabric from source and want to enable verbs support, you will also need the matching header files for the above two libraries.
